snippet.title: Necrophosis: Full Consciousness - Official Announcement Trailer | IGN Fan Fest 2026
snippet.description:
Take a look at Necrophosis: Full Consciousness, an upcoming first-person Lovecraftian horror experience. Step into a nightmarish realm filled with grotesque forms and ominous visuals, solving unnerving puzzles and uncovering secrets along the way. 

Necrophosis: Full Consciousness will be available as a complete edition on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Steam.

#IGN #Gaming #FanFest
